rust_summary: an item's default components on `Host` (`native_item_default_component`), which `ItemResource::with_component` and `without_component` read to keep a stack's patch as vanilla's; and `ItemResource::has_enchantment_effect`, sealed glue behind it (`native_item_has_enchantment_effect`).
doc_summary: `item_default_component(item, component)` is an item's default value of a data component (`Item.components().get`), with data packs' and mods' changes, or none where it hasn't one; `ItemResource::with_component(host, &id, value)` drops a value equal to it from a stack's patch, and `without_component(host, &id)` records a removal (`!id`) of one the item has, as vanilla's `PatchedDataComponentMap.set` and `remove` do. `ItemResource::has_enchantment_effect(host, PREVENT_ARMOR_CHANGE)` is `EnchantmentHelper.has`: whether an enchantment on the item has an effect type (`EnchantmentEffect`, a mod's own by `EnchantmentEffect::new`), by the enchantments' definitions, data packs' included, not their ids. Bundles need "hooks": @API:item_components@.
